description: This file defines base classes and mechanisms for Large Language Model (LLM) services with function calling support, including registration, execution, and management of function calls, as well as event handling and frame processing.

classes.name: FunctionCallResultCallback
classes.description: Protocol for callback handling the result of an LLM function call execution.

classes.name: FunctionCallParams
classes.description: Data class holding parameters for a function call, including function name, arguments, context, and callback.

classes.name: FunctionCallRegistryItem
classes.description: Represents a registered function handler with associated metadata, used in function call registration.

classes.name: FunctionCallRunnerItem
classes.description: Internal data class for managing function call execution, including handler info, arguments, and context.

classes.name: LLMService
classes.description: Base class for Large Language Model services supporting function call registration, execution, and frame processing.

methods.name: get_llm_adapter
methods.description: Returns the LLM adapter instance used for communication.

methods.name: create_llm_specific_message
methods.description: Creates an LLM-specific message for use in an LLMContext.

methods.name: run_inference
methods.description: Abstract method to run inference with a given LLM context; must be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: create_context_aggregator
methods.description: Creates a context aggregator for managing LLM conversation context; deprecated.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the LLM service, optionally creating a sequential runner task.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the LLM service, cancelling the sequential runner task if needed.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Cancels the LLM service, cancelling the sequential runner task if needed.

methods.name: process_frame
methods.description: Processes a frame, handling interruptions and configuration updates.

methods.name: push_frame
methods.description: Pushes a frame into the processing pipeline, modifying TTS skip flag if applicable.

methods.name: _handle_interruptions
methods.description: Handles interruption frames by cancelling registered functions with cancel_on_interruption set.

methods.name: register_function
methods.description: Registers a function handler for LLM function calls, with optional start callback and interruption behavior.

methods.name: register_direct_function
methods.description: Registers a direct function handler, extracting metadata automatically.

methods.name: unregister_function
methods.description: Removes a registered function handler by name.

methods.name: unregister_direct_function
methods.description: Removes a direct function handler.

methods.name: has_function
methods.description: Checks if a function handler is registered for a given name.

methods.name: run_function_calls
methods.description: Executes a sequence of function calls, triggering start events and handling calls in parallel or sequentially.

methods.name: request_image_frame
methods.description: Deprecated method to request an image from a user, pushes a UserImageRequestFrame.

methods.name: _create_sequential_runner_task
methods.description: Creates a background task for sequentially running function calls.

methods.name: _cancel_sequential_runner_task
methods.description: Cancels the sequential runner background task.

methods.name: _sequential_runner_handler
methods.description: Background handler for executing queued function calls sequentially.

methods.name: _run_parallel_function_calls
methods.description: Runs multiple function calls in parallel.

methods.name: _run_sequential_function_calls
methods.description: Enqueues function calls for sequential execution.

methods.name: _call_start_function
methods.description: Invokes the start callback for a function if registered.

methods.name: _run_function_call
methods.description: Executes a single function call, handling both direct and regular handlers, with error handling and callback invocation.

methods.name: _cancel_function_call
methods.description: Cancels ongoing function calls matching a given name.

methods.name: _function_call_task_finished
methods.description: Callback for when a function call task completes, cleaning up tracking.
